title: Tool
description: A tool definition. Authored once; the runtime picks transport (native in-process for tools built into the runtime, MCP over the wire for cross-process / cross-org / third-party tools). Every tool declares its typed I/O, its context needs (typed DI), and its side-effects — enabling policy enforcement and parallel scheduling by the kernel.

id.description: Unique tool identifier. Convention: '<pack>.<tool>' (e.g. 'acme.verify-citation') or a bare id for tools built into Kindgi.

description.description: Human- and LLM-readable description of what this tool does. Load-bearing: this is what the LLM sees when deciding to call the tool.

input.description: JSON Schema for the tool input. MUST validate under Draft 2020-12, except on an MCP server's tool (`transport: "mcp"`), whose schemas are in the dialect their `$schema` declares: draft-06, draft-07, 2019-09 or 2020-12.

output.description: JSON Schema for the tool output. MUST validate under Draft 2020-12, except on an MCP server's tool (`transport: "mcp"`), whose schemas are in the dialect their `$schema` declares: draft-06, draft-07, 2019-09 or 2020-12.

needs.description: Typed context requirements — named slots (e.g. `tenant`, `run`, `blob`, `memory:facts`) the runtime injects via `ToolContext`. Declarative: not checked when a flow is loaded. `needsSpec` is the typed, discriminated form.

effects.description: Declared side-effects. Enables policy enforcement (can this tool run in this tenant?), safe parallelization (are two calls conflicting?), and causal provenance.

transport.description: Transport hint. 'auto' (default) lets the runtime pick native when possible, MCP otherwise. 'native' requires in-process execution. 'mcp' requires MCP execution. Deployment-time concern; authoring is unchanged.

mcpEndpoint.description: If transport = 'mcp' (or resolved to MCP by 'auto'), the MCP endpoint URI. Format: 'mcp+stdio://<command>', 'mcp+http://<url>', 'mcp+sse://<url>'.

metadata.description: Free-form annotations (author, docs URL, tags). Not interpreted by the kernel.

sandbox.description: Isolation posture the runtime enforces around the handler. Optional additive field.

mutating.description: Semantic marker: `true` when this tool causes observable side effects (writes state, calls external APIs with mutations, sends messages). Read-only tools set `false`. Absent defaults to `true`. Consumed by the HITL default classifier — a read-only tool passes straight through, a mutating tool asks on first use.

limits.description: Sandbox-enforced resource caps at dispatch. Optional additive field.

network.description: Network egress policy. Optional additive field. Discriminated on `kind`.

needsSpec.description: Typed discriminated needs (env / secrets / config / capabilities / bindings). Optional additive field.

codeArtifactRef.description: Handler-artifact pointer. Discriminated on `kind`: `oci` is the deploy-pipeline shape (image + module path + artifactVersion); `filesystem` is the local-development shape — absolute host path at the pack's on-disk handler file. Production servers SHOULD reject `filesystem`.

spec.description: Declarative handler spec. Discriminated on `kind`; the framework's synthesizer registry maps kind → runtime handler. Mutually exclusive with an imperative handler at author time.

resource.description: Resource identifier (e.g. 'memory:facts', 'blob:*', 'external:api.example.com'). Used by the policy engine to authorize the effect.

HttpToolSpec.description: Declarative HTTP-invocation spec. Attached to `ToolManifest.spec` under the discriminant `kind: 'http'`. The runtime `Tool.handler` is synthesized by the 'http' spec synthesizer to perform URL-template substitution, secret-ref resolution via `ToolContext.resolveSecret`, and the outbound fetch. All fields serialize cleanly to JSON.

urlTemplate.description: URL template with `{param}` placeholders substituted from the tool's input at invoke time.

parseJson.description: When true (default), the response body is parsed as JSON before returning to the invoker.
